chunks.title: SAP (SAP) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: SAP is a Strategic Corporate / COP31 Supporter headquartered in Germany. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Enterprise sustainability software & carbon accounting ecosystem participant. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Corporate carbon ledger, ESG reporting & supply-chain MRV ecosystem partnerships. Source verification: https://www.sap.com/sustainability.html.

chunks.title: SAP Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: SAP provides the following climate financing instruments: Enterprise Co-Sell / Ecosystem Partnership, SAP.iO Venture Referral. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 0 to USD 10,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Large Corporate.

chunks.title: SAP Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by SAP: Climate-Tech Innovation, Industrial Decarbonization, Circular Economy & Zero Waste, Carbon Markets & Article 6. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: SAP Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete SAP's application form: API / Green Ledger MRV interoperability value proposition; IP-safe Level 1 PUBLIC sharing only. Explicit exclusion rules: Assuming direct grant funding from enterprise software partner. Official application portal: https://www.sap.com/sustainability.html.

chunks.title: SAP Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: SAP uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
